The paper develops randomization-based regression-adjustment theory under rerandomization, recommends regression adjustment with Huber–White variance, and analyzes estimated precision; it does not analyze PSRR stopping paths.
The paper constructs Gaussian-prepivoted randomization tests that are exact under sharp nulls and asymptotically valid under weak nulls, with rerandomization among its examples.
